name: webforms-workflow-retrieval
description: Authored lexical-search regression corpus for WebForms workflows; synthetic source, not private application or semantic/model-quality evidence.

queries.query: where are login credentials validated against a password hash
queries.rationale: ValidateCredentials rejects empty input and verifies the account password hash.
CanComplete compares each group uploaded count with RequiredImageCount.

queries.query: map layer visibility owning project shared
queries.rationale: IsVisible checks owning project or an explicitly shared layer.

queries.query: CSV export semicolon separator empty fields
queries.rationale: exportRows quotes fields, preserves empty cells and joins with a semicolon.

queries.query: display remaining required photos beside upload button
queries.rationale: renderPhotoBadge computes and displays the remaining count.

queries.query: table required image count photo group marker type
queries.rationale: PhotoRequirement stores RequiredImageCount by marker type and photo group.

queries.query: bind project visible layers grid DataSource DataBind
queries.rationale: LoadLayers assigns the filtered records and binds the WebForms grid.
validateImageUpload rejects non-images and files above maxBytes.
